description: List tokens trending on Robinhood Chain (Robinhood's Arbitrum L2, home of the NOXA Fun / fun.noxa.fi memecoin scene) right now, with price, market cap, 24h volume, and the token's contract address. FREE, read-only, no wallet. Use this to answer 'what's hot on Robinhood Chain' and to get the exact contract address to pass to xpay_trade. Pass newOnly:true for the freshest launches (higher risk). This is Robinhood *Chain* on-chain data - unrelated to the Robinhood brokerage app or stock trading.

newOnly.description: Show newest pools instead of trending. Default false.
